Sana R: quick heads-up — cert rollover for acme-private is scheduled for 2026-04-08 03:00 UTC. blockers: airgap key-exchange failing on staging, bandwidth tests flaking. need owners for cert push + net thumbs. @kevin @jorge

Kevin L: I can take cert push if net confirms egress rules. have a CR ready: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/certs/+/2345

Jorge P: net teams seeing proxy _drop_ at 10.1.4.0/24 during handshake. opening ticket NET-487.

Alex M: pinging infra-ops for canary plan — i'd like 1-node canary in staging, then 3-node in prod. who will trigger?

Sana R: thanks. canary owner = Kevin L? also need rollback path: keep old cert in secret manager until 48h after rollout.

Kevin L: yep i'll own canary. steps in runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/cert-rotation

Sana R: quick smoke command for cert check:

`````
curl -v --resolve acme.private:443:10.2.3.4 https://acme.private/health --cacert /tmp/new-ca.pem
`````

Kevin L: note — for airgap sites we need signed bundle and signed manifest. @Ops-Bot please remind on deploy window

Ops-Bot: Reminder scheduled: cert-rollover-acme at 2026-04-08T03:00:00Z — participants: Kevin L, Jorge P, Sana R

Jorge P: NET-487 update: proxy vendor confirms SNI passthrough bug; workaround: add tcp route on bgp edge. ETA 6h.

Alex M: flag for product — there may be a short 20s TLS blip during failover. @product-lead FYI :warning:

Sana R: okay — timeline adjusted. if NET can't fix in 6h we'll hold and do manual edge route change. Kevin, can you prepare a one-command rollback?

Kevin L: prepared in PR 2346 — `kubectl set secret certs/acme --from-file=old.pem` — tested on staging.

Sana R: thanks all. i'll update runbook and post final go/no-go 02:30UTC. :thumbsup:
